exposure: patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) with hydromorphone combined with sufentanil
outcome: adverse reactions (chills, pruritus, nausea and vomiting, respiratory depression, dizziness)
cohort: The study included 130 parturients undergoing cesarean sections under spinal anesthesia.
finding: The combination of hydromorphone and sufentanil in PCIA significantly reduced postoperative pain scores and improved depressive and anxiety scores at 6 weeks postoperatively compared to sufentanil alone, without significant differences in operative time, first ambulation, sleep quality, or adverse reactions.
